Class Java

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.ToolContext
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.AnahataToolkit
uno.anahata.asi.toolkit.java.Java
All Implemented Interfaces:
ContextProvider, PropertyChangeSource, Rebindable
Direct Known Subclasses:
DesktopJava
public class Java extends AnahataToolkit
A powerful toolkit for compiling and executing Java code dynamically within the application's JVM. It provides a "hot-reload" capability by using a child-first classloader and supports context-aware execution through the OnTheFlyAgiTool base class.
Author:
anahata

  • Field Details

    • parentFirstClassess

      protected final Set<String> parentFirstClassess
      A set of infrastructure classes that MUST always be loaded by the parent classloader (the ASI engine) to preserve static state and ThreadLocal context. This prevents "Identity Crisis" issues where a child-loaded script cannot access the engine's context.

    • defaultCompilerClasspath

      public String defaultCompilerClasspath
      The base compiler and classloader classpath. Extra entries can be provided at execution time. This serves as the foundation for both dynamic compilation and the child-first classloader logic.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Performs initial setup for a newly created toolkit instance.

      This method is called exactly once by the ToolManager after the toolkit has been instantiated and registered. It provides a clean hook for toolkits to perform one-time initialization logic that requires the tool environment to be fully configured, such as scanning for project instructions or registering default resources.

      Empty implementation as per architectural refinement. Initialization logic is moved to postActivate() and setDefaultClasspath(String).

      Overrides:
      initialize in class AnahataToolkit

    • logClassloading

      public static void logClassloading(String message)
      Emits a high-salience classloading lifecycle log message.

      If called within an active tool execution thread, it logs directly to the active JavaMethodToolResponse so the AI model and developer see classloader events live in the tool response. If called outside a tool execution thread, it logs to SLF4J at INFO level.

      Parameters:
      message - the classloading log message.

    • getKnownJdks

      public List<KnownJdk> getKnownJdks()
      Discovers all known JDK installations on the host environment.

      Scans: 1. The currently running JVM (via System.getProperty("java.home")). 2. The JAVA_HOME environment variable. 3. Standard platform JDK directories (/usr/lib/jvm, /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines, C:\Program Files\Java, etc.). 4. The javac executable available on the system PATH.

      Subclasses (such as NbJava and IntellijJava) override this method to add IDE-registered platforms and project SDKs.

      Returns:
      a list of discovered KnownJdk instances.

    • compile

      public Class<?> compile(String sourceCode, String className, String extraClassPath, String[] compilerOptions, Path javacPath) throws Exception
      Compiles Java source code into a Class object.

      Resolution order: 1. If an explicit javacPath is provided, compiles externally using that binary. 2. If javacPath is null and in-memory JavaCompiler is available, compiles in memory. 3. If javacPath is null and in-memory compiler is NOT available (JRE/JBR), automatically falls back to the first available JDK javac from getKnownJdks().

      Parameters:
      sourceCode - the Java source code to compile.
      className - the simple or fully qualified name of the class.
      extraClassPath - additional classpath entries to include.
      compilerOptions - additional options for the compiler.
      javacPath - optional explicit path to a javac executable.
      Returns:
      the compiled Class object.
      Throws:
      Exception - if compilation or classloading fails.

    • compileWithExternalJavac

      protected Class<?> compileWithExternalJavac(String sourceCode, String className, String extraClassPath, String[] compilerOptions, Path javacPath) throws Exception
      Compiles Java source code using an external javac process and loads the resulting class.

      Robust implementation: 1. Writes all compiler options to an @argfile to completely bypass OS/Windows command-line length limits. 2. Enforces matching --release bytecode compatibility to avoid UnsupportedClassVersionError. 3. Performs atomic cleanup of the scratch directory in a finally block (zero disk leaks).

      Parameters:
      sourceCode - the Java source code.
      className - the simple class name.
      extraClassPath - optional additional classpath entries.
      compilerOptions - optional compiler options.
      javacPath - the absolute path to the javac executable.
      Returns:
      the loaded Class.
      Throws:
      Exception - on compilation or classloading failure.

    • compile

      public String compile(List<AgiClassSource> sources, String extraClassPath, String[] compilerOptions, String jdk) throws Exception
      Compiles one or more modular Java classes into the in-memory classpath of this AGI session without executing them.

      The compiled classes are registered in the session's RAM and automatically included in the RAG message as context providers. Passing multiple sources compiles them simultaneously, allowing mutual or circular dependencies (e.g. Class A references Class B and Class B references Class A).

      Parameters:
      sources - List of Java class source descriptors (each containing fqn and sourceCode).
      extraClassPath - Optional extra classpath entries separated by File.pathSeparator.
      compilerOptions - Optional compiler options.
      jdk - Optional JDK name (from Available JDKs) or explicit path to javac binary.
      Returns:
      Confirmation message with compilation summary.
      Throws:
      Exception - on compilation error.

    • setProviding

      public String setProviding(List<String> fqns, boolean providing)
      Sets whether one or more in-memory compiled classes should have their full source code included in the RAG message.
      Parameters:
      fqns - List of class fully qualified names to update providing status for.
      providing - Whether to include the source code in the RAG message.
      Returns:
      Confirmation message.

    • getAgiClassSources

      public Map<String,String> getAgiClassSources(List<String> classFqns)
      Retrieves the stored Java source code for one or more previously compiled AGI classes. If a requested class is already providing its source code in the RAG message, an error is logged and an informative notice is returned instead to avoid prompt token duplication.
      Parameters:
      classFqns - List of class fully qualified names to retrieve source code for.
      Returns:
      Map of class FQN to its Java source code.
